The '''Darellia system''' was a part of the [[Arrowhead]] region in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the creature known as the [[Darellian fire crab]].<ref name="AotC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Darellia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-10.<ref name="TEA" />
